# Contract: writing-plans

Third-party skill from [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) (MIT, Jesse Vincent), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (An implementation plan before coding). The method is upstream. Category: planning. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
Turn a spec into an implementation plan: files, signatures, and the test that proves each small task, written before any code.

## Use it for
- "write an implementation plan for this spec"
- "plan the code change before you start"

## Not for
- a personal brain dump and one next action (next-step)
- a long video shot list (long-form-storyboard)

## Accepted inputs
A spec or requirements for a multi-step code change.

## Deliverables
A plan file of bite-sized tasks with the test for each.
